messages:
Maya: Hey folks — first day! Can someone point me to the fastest path to get Datadog/Grafana/Sentry access? I need to check service latency and error spikes for my integration. Also: who owns the onboarding dashboard? :wave:

onboarding-bot: Welcome, @maya! Please run /onboard and request Observability Access (Datadog, Grafana, Sentry). A member of devex will triage within 24h.

Devon: Hi @maya — quick checklist:
1) SSO group: request 'obs-read' or 'obs-edit' via the internal portal
2) File ticket in #help with your org/team
3) For Grafana, ask to be added to the 'apps' org (we use folders for permissions)
If you want edit rights say 'edit'

Carlos: Adding some links: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboarding
Datadog runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/datadog-quickstart
Also you can test access with:
```
curl -H "DD-API-KEY: $DD_KEY" https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/validate
```

sre-jen: @maya I maintain the onboarding dashboard 'Oncall / New Hires — Overview' under Grafana > Dashboards > Team Dashboards. I can clone and give you a view-only link. If you need to see traces set span sampling to 1% in Sentry for a short window. DM me and I’ll add you.

Maya: Awesome — request sent via /onboard and ticket #OBS-452. I requested obs-edit. Thanks @Devon @sre-jen @Carlos :raised_hands: 

Devon: If you want to quickly check error rate in Grafana, panel query is something like:
```
sum(rate(requests_errors_total[5m])) by (service)
```

Carlos: For Datadog, to filter by service and env use: service:my-api AND env:staging
Also the quick monitor snippet we use for spikes:
```
{"name":"Error spike - my-api","query":"avg(last_5m):avg:requests.errors{service:my-api} > 100"}
```

sre-jen: I invited you to the Grafana folder, you should see 'Team Dashboards' in the left nav. If anything missing ping me here and I’ll escalate to infra.

Maya: I can see the dashboard, traces coming through, and Datadog validate passed. Closing loop — thanks everyone! :tada:
